rationale: Empirical lens, round 3 at a86d0bdd (worktree HEAD verified, git status clean, left byte-identical). The new TestDraftSpecStatusWithCache_BranchOnlyDraft_ShadowTagDoesNotHideIt passes including under -race, and the qualified-ref change is correct as far as it goes: on my hand-built shadow-tag fixture (real spec-create shape from round 2 — branch-only draft spec/130-branch-only-draft, plus a same-named tag on main), `git cat-file -e refs/heads/spec/130-...:.mindspec/specs/130-.../spec.md` exits 0 while the short-name form warns 'refname is ambiguous' and resolves against the tag (exit 128), and `state show --spec 130-branch-only-draft` at a86d0bdd correctly renders mode:spec. BUT the hand-probe of the AMBIENT path — the headline G3 scenario, `state show` from main with no flag — still renders bare {"mode":"idle"} exit 0 with the shadow tag present, and flips to mode:spec the moment the tag is deleted (verified both directions on the same fixture, nothing else changed). Root cause isolated: the tag-shadow evasion has TWO legs and the fix closed only one. DiscoverDraftSpecsWithCache builds its branch-leg candidate set from gitutil.LocalBranchRefs (internal/resolve/resolve.go:158), which runs `for-each-ref --format=%(refname:short) refs/heads`; under a same-named tag, git's short-name computation disambiguates the branch to 'heads/spec/130-branch-only-draft' (verified: for-each-ref output in the fixture), so strings.CutPrefix(b, "spec/") fails silently and the draft never enters the candidate set — draftSpecStatusWithCache's now-correct qualified-ref probe is never even called for it on the ambient path. The round-3 regression test misses this because it calls draftSpecStatusWithCache and ResolveModeWithCache directly with the known specID and never exercises DiscoverDraftSpecsWithCache or the state-show level. So the commit message's claim ('a same-named tag ... reverting a genuine branch-only draft to {"mode":"idle"} exit 0' is fixed) holds only for explicitly-targeted specs; the ambient scenario — the one a tag-carrying clone actually hits, since tags arrive via normal `git fetch` — still fabricates bare idle exit 0. Classification of the round-2 ask: PARTIAL (tree-probe leg ADDRESSED, enumeration leg MISSED). My round-1/round-2 approvals otherwise stand — the full repro set (flag propagation, G2 flaky-bd recovery, G3 without a shadow tag, half-drafts, bd-dead refusals) re-verified unchanged at a86d0bdd.
concrete_changes_required: Close the enumeration leg of the tag-shadow evasion: DiscoverDraftSpecsWithCache's branch candidate enumeration must yield true branch names even when a same-named tag exists. Empirical repro at a86d0bdd: round-2's branch-only-draft fixture + `git tag spec/130-branch-only-draft main`; ambient `state show` from main renders bare {"mode":"idle"} exit 0 with the tag present and mode:spec without it, because `for-each-ref --format=%(refname:short) refs/heads` emits 'heads/spec/130-branch-only-draft' under ambiguity, defeating the SpecBranchPrefix cut in resolve.go:158-166 silently. Fix options (implementer's choice): switch the refs/heads enumeration to `%(refname:lstrip=2)` (verified in the fixture to emit 'spec/130-branch-only-draft' under the shadow; for refs/heads lstrip=2 IS the branch name, and short-vs-lstrip only diverge exactly when short is wrong) — either in gitutil.LocalBranchRefs itself (sanity-check its other consumers: internal/layout/precondition.go, internal/lifecycle/finalize_orphans.go, executor interface — they plausibly want the same de-ambiguated names) or via a discovery-scoped helper. AND extend the shadow-tag regression coverage to the level that was actually broken: assert DiscoverDraftSpecsWithCache (or the state-show ambient fixture) finds the draft with the shadow tag present — red-on-revert against the %(refname:short) enumeration, which the round-3 test does not catch.

findings.summary: Round-2 shadow-tag ask only half-fixed. ADDRESSED: draftSpecStatusWithCache's tree probe now uses refs/heads/<branch>, verified correct by the new unit test and by `state show --spec <id>` on the hand fixture. MISSED: the ambient discovery path still hides the draft — LocalBranchRefs's %(refname:short) output mutates to 'heads/spec/<id>' under a same-named tag, the spec/ prefix cut fails silently, and ambient `state show` from main renders bare {"mode":"idle"} exit 0 (flips to mode:spec when the tag is deleted; verified both directions on one fixture at a86d0bdd). The regression test pins only the fixed leg (direct draftSpecStatusWithCache/ResolveModeWithCache calls), not DiscoverDraftSpecsWithCache or the state-show level where the bug lives.

Everything from my rounds 1-2 remains verified at a86d0bdd: flag-blind propagation repros all refuse by name; G2 flaky-bd recovery renders the epic's real phase; G3 branch-only draft discovered ambiently when NO shadow tag exists; bd-dead refusals non-zero; half-drafts honest idle; the shadow-tag unit test passes under -race. The requested change is narrow (one enumeration format + one test extension); no other regressions found.
